_comment: The ONLY limits in Marketing Kit: the ones each provider enforces itself (Resend, Telnyx, Expo Push, Web Push, WhatsApp, Apple/Google platform rules, and — when you set them up — PayPal Payouts, YouTube, TikTok One, Meta). No kit caps, windows or policies. Account-specific values (your Resend rate, your 10DLC class) override via env. Re-verify against the sources when a provider changes plans — mkt-doctor --live prints them.

resend.burst: none — the 11th request in the same second gets 429
resend.rate_limit_scope: per team (all API keys share it)

quota.counts: sent + received; each To/CC/BCC recipient counts as one email

errors.429 monthly_quota_exceeded: hold until the next billing month
errors.403 contacts quota: broadcasts blocked until the Marketing plan is upgraded

resend.provider_suppression: Resend will not deliver to addresses that hard-bounced or marked spam (its own suppression list)

sender_mps.long_code_us: set by your 10DLC campaign class (AT&T TPM) — put yours in TELNYX_SENDER_MPS

provider_blocks_recipient.40300: recipient texted STOP — Telnyx refuses until they text START

paypal_payouts.retry: on HTTP 5xx retry with the SAME sender_batch_id (never a new one)
paypal_payouts.venmo: recipient_type PHONE (US mobile) + recipient_wallet VENMO; note is required

meta.rate_limits: Business Use Case limits per ad account/app, reported in the X-Business-Use-Case-Usage header; back off when it nears 100%
meta.ad_policies: Meta reviews every ad against its own advertising standards; rejected ads are a provider limit

whatsapp.via: Telnyx (same account + SDK as SMS: client.messages.whatsapp)

messaging_limit_unique_users_24h.scope: business portfolio, shared by all its numbers; counts only business-initiated messages outside the 24h customer-service window

errors.40008: WhatsApp only: template pending / rejected / paused / disabled, or delivery failure (Telnyx catch-all) → failed, not retried. On SMS 40008 stays in telnyx.errors.retry_backoff

expo_push.receipts: fetch ~15 min after sending (worker does it in its drain loop, no timer)

errors.DeviceNotRegistered: stop sending to that token (worker revokes the device)
errors.MessageRateExceeded: too fast to one device — back off and retry

expo_push.access_token_env: EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN (only if enhanced push security is on)

web_push.note: RFC 8030: push services MUST accept bodies ≤4096 bytes; aes128gcm adds 103 bytes → keep JSON ≤3993
web_push.ios: iOS/iPadOS 16.4+ only for web apps added to the Home Screen

app_platforms.ios_review_prompt: system shows it at most 3 times per 365 days; not again for a version already rated
app_platforms.android_in_app_review: Google quota, undisclosed — call only at peak moments
app_platforms.adservices_retry: 404 = not ready: retry up to 3 times ~5s apart
